answer.rationale: The primary contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line runs at 94% with no buffer, so deferral and a primary switch both raise delivery risk; a second-source add leaves the expiring primary unaddressed and we have only one decision. Renegotiation at renewal previously recovered price and terms (c4) while incumbent continuity avoided integration/delivery interruption (c1); a longer commitment can unlock volume pricing without narrowing scope (c6). Negotiate the incumbent renewal to pursue the spend cut without changing the supply path. Whether benchmarking can reach a full 18% remains uncertain.
